limitations: SCREENING/INCONCLUSIVE: GPU isolation is unestablished; no fair performance comparison or promotion can be claimed.

No quality qualification. All raw samples and outliers retained.
The verbose-JIT CLI startup failure and subsequent fix are separate from the measured f9 source.
Physical GPU reservation changed after this run; future comparisons require their own provenance and conditioning.

harness.scope: C1 then C64 screening only, without full conditioning matrix; not a formal v4/v5 trial.

isolation.observation_source: Campaign operator post-run NVIDIA process inspection
isolation.observation: Immediately after the run, a foreign pytest process held 1118 MiB on the first assigned GPU. Process start was approximately 12:51 local time, but allocation overlap was not continuously timestamped.
isolation.interpretation: Isolation during timed requests is not established. This does not prove that CUDA allocation or execution overlapped the measurements.
isolation.action: Released that GPU without modifying the foreign job; future reservations use a different GPU pair. Host device indices and foreign PID are omitted from the public record.
